failures.question: 每个月的订单量环比增长率是多少？
failures.generatedSql:
WITH monthly_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    date_trunc('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
    COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY month
  ORDER BY month
),
monthly_growth AS (
  SELECT 
    month,
    order_count,
    lag(order_count) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_month_count
  FROM monthly_orders
)
SELECT 
  month,
  order_count,
  prev_month_count,
  CASE 
    WHEN prev_month_count IS NULL OR prev_month_count = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ((order_count - prev_month_count) * 100.0 / prev_month_count)
  END AS growth_rate_percent
FROM monthly_growth
ORDER BY month
LIMIT 24;

-- 非会员复购情况
non_member_repurchases AS (
    SELECT 
        o1.customer_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o1.order_id) AS total_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o2.order_id IS NOT NULL THEN o1.order_id END) AS repurchase_orders
    FROM 
        orders o1
    LEFT JOIN 
        orders o2 ON o1.customer_id = o2.customer_id 
        AND o2.order_purchase_timestamp > o1.order_purchase_timestamp
    WHERE 
        o1.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT customer_unique_id FROM members)
    GROUP BY 
        o1.customer_id
)
-- 计算复购率
SELECT 
    '会员' AS customer_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customer_count,
    SUM(total_orders) AS total_orders,
    SUM(repurchase_orders) AS repurchase_orders,
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(total_orders) = 0 THEN 0 
        ELSE SUM(repurchase_orders) * 100.0 / SUM(total_orders) 
    END AS repurchase_rate
FROM 
    member_repurchases
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    '非会员' AS customer_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customer_count,
    SUM(total_orders) AS total_orders,
    SUM(repurchase_orders) AS repurchase_orders,
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(total_orders) = 0 THEN 0 
        ELSE SUM(repurchase_orders) * 100.0 / SUM(total_orders) 
    END AS repurchase_rate
FROM 
    non_member_repurchases
LIMIT 2;

failures.question: 各仓库的库存周转情况：当前库存量、近 90 天出库量、库存周转天数分别是多少？

SELECT 
    w.warehouse_name,
    COALESCE(i.current_quantity, 0) AS current_quantity,
    COALESCE(o.outbound_quantity_90d, 0) AS outbound_quantity_90d,
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(o.outbound_quantity_90d, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ROUND(i.current_quantity * 90.0 / o.outbound_quantity_90d, 2)
    END AS inventory_turnover_days
FROM 
    warehouses w

    (SELECT warehouse_id, SUM(quantity) AS current_quantity FROM inventory GROUP BY warehouse_id) i
    ON w.warehouse_id = i.warehouse_id
LEFT JOIN

        inventory_movements im
     WHERE

        AND im.moved_at <= (SELECT MAX(order_purchase_timestamp) FROM orders)
     GROUP BY 
        im.warehouse_id
    ) o
    ON w.warehouse_id = o.warehouse_id
ORDER BY 
    w.warehouse_name

failures.question: 2018 年每个月的 GMV 中，新客和老客各贡献多少？
failures.generatedSql:
WITH 
-- 获取2018年所有订单
orders_2018 AS (
    SELECT 
        order_id,
        customer_id,
        order_purchase_timestamp,
        -- 计算价格总和（GMV）
        (SELECT SUM(price) FROM order_items WHERE order_items.order_id = orders.order_id) AS gmv
    FROM orders
    WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01 00:00:00' 
    AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01 00:00:00'
),
-- 获取每个客户的最早订单日期（判断是否为新客）
customer_first_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        MIN(order_purchase_timestamp) AS first_order_date
    FROM orders
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
-- 标记2018年订单中的新客和老客
labeled_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        o.order_id,
        o.customer_id,
        o.order_purchase_timestamp,
        o.gmv,
        CASE 
            WHEN cfo.first_order_date >= '2018-01-01 00:00:00' 
                 AND cfo.first_order_date <= '2018-12-31 23:59:59' THEN 'new'
            ELSE 'old'
        END AS customer_type
    FROM orders_2018 o
    JOIN customer_first_orders cfo ON o.customer_id = cfo.customer_id
)
-- 按月份和新老客类型汇总GMV
SELECT 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
    customer_type,
    SUM(gmv) AS total_gmv
FROM labeled_orders
GROUP BY month, customer_type
ORDER BY month, customer_type
LIMIT 24;
